_readme: Every number here comes from evaluating the ACTUAL deployed file in this repo (not an earlier/different checkpoint) on the same shared 845-image test split. CNN/MobileNetV2/ResNet50/Feature Fusion numbers were cross-verified two ways: (1) each notebook's own classification_report() on load, and (2) independently recomputed from real per-image prediction CSVs in 04_Visualize_result_model.ipynb. Both agree exactly. Regenerate this file if any model file is retrained/replaced.

CNN.source: stb_v2_ADV_CNN_4class_Comparison.ipynb final cell (loads AdvancedCNN_none_classweight.keras, evaluates on test_split.csv); cross-verified from cnn_predictions.csv in 04_Visualize_result_model.ipynb

MobileNetV2.source: stb_v2_mobilenetv2.ipynb final cell (downloads deployed mobilenetv2_model.keras from Drive, evaluates on test_split.csv); cross-verified from mobilenetv2_predictions.csv in 04_Visualize_result_model.ipynb

ResNet50.source: stb_v2_resnet50_garbage_classification.ipynb final cell (downloads deployed resnet50_model_quantized.tflite from Drive, evaluates on test_split.csv); cross-verified from resnet50_predictions.csv in 04_Visualize_result_model.ipynb

ResNet50+CLIP.source: 03_Feature_Fusion.ipynb final cell (downloads deployed resnet50_clip_fusion_final.tflite from Drive, evaluates on test_split.csv); cross-verified from resnet50_clip_fusion_predictions.csv in 04_Visualize_result_model.ipynb

CLIP Linear Probe.note: Not shipped as a standalone file in the app — runs live inside CLIP Verify only (see clip_linear_probe.pt + load_clip_verify_bundle() in app.py). Included here for comparison, not as a deployable option.
CLIP Linear Probe.source: 02_CLIP_LinearProbe.ipynb; verified from clip_linearprobe_predictions.csv in 04_Visualize_result_model.ipynb (per-class values derived from its confusion matrix, cell 12)

clip_verify.threshold_note: Fixed in advance (CLIP_VERIFY_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD in app.py), NOT searched on this test set — see clip_verify_threshold_search.py for the validation-set-only search this should be paired with.
clip_verify.verdict: Does not beat ResNet50 alone (96.21% vs 97.16%)
